decisions_made: All nine local branches deleted: bimodal_refactor, feature/bimodal-cvc5-pilot, feature/bimodal_witness, feature/bimodal_witness_backup, feature/cvc5-feasibility-test, feature/quantifier-free-witnesses, feature/witness-falsity-attempt, new_claude, refactor/exclusion. Each was archived to a verified, self-contained git bundle at /home/benjamin/branch-archive/ModelChecker/ before deletion.

Deletion ran only after all three gates passed in the same execution: Gate A (verdict report exists, names all nine), Gate B (re-ran every Phase 1/2 content assertion), Gate C (re-verified all nine bundles green). No branch was deleted before this.

Documentation was written to match the actual current tree rather than the research report's characterization where the two diverged: `_witness_constraint_for_falsity()` in witness_constraints.py is an unreached placeholder (bare `pass`), not the active Box falsity mechanism -- the real mechanism is `z3.ForAll`/`z3.Exists` directly in NecessityOperator (operators.py). Similarly, cvc5_adapter.py has no `apply_function` method today, so the segfault risk is described as applying a declared function through the cvc5 backend generally, not a still-live call site.

Remote ref count is 11, not the plan's stated 10 (origin/HEAD plus 10 named refs). Verified unchanged before and after deletion (11 == 11), which is the actual safety property; recorded as a pre-existing miscount in the plan/research, not a regression.
No code was ported (research classified zero branches (b) reusable code as-is), so no tests were added or run; validation was entirely documentation-content and git-state checks, all of which passed.
No git push, no remote mutation, no merge of any stale branch, and no checkout occurred at any point -- HEAD stayed on task-140-fix-bimodal-order-dependence throughout.
dead_ends: Do not describe the falsity-constraint mechanism as living in witness_constraints.py's _witness_constraint_for_falsity() -- it is dead scaffolding, never called outside its own tests. Grep for a symbol's definition is not evidence it is on the active code path; grep for call sites too.
